description: issue #679 (SP7): the OFF half of the reserved-word profile gate. The same three `define`s CHECK CLEAN under `core-language` alone, because `tell`/`ask`/`each` are reserved only within the Sprites profile and are deliberately not in the Core reserved-word list (spec/turtles-and-sprites.md:154). So a Core program that already defines procedures with those names still checks clean until it opts into Sprites. This is a `"check": true` fixture: it asserts the absence of the checker diagnostic, not execution — the procedures are never called and no events are produced.
